label: Ubiquitination, deubiquitination and proteasome
reason: Nearly all members are ubiquitin chain types, DUB families, neddylation/CSN and proteasome assembly; RB1/BCL2L1 module is a lone misfit.

label: Megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
reason: RUNX1, megakaryocyte/platelet and erythrocyte differentiation terms plus MkE BTM modules; only the TAK1/ATF module is off-theme.

label: Protein quality control and ubiquitin-proteasome degradation
reason: Ubiquitin/DUB/proteasome terms with misfolded-protein handling, aggrephagy, ERAD and RQC form one proteostasis theme; Golgi reassembly and chromatin module are minor misfits.

label: Biogenic amine and organic cation catabolism
reason: MAO/COMT dopamine and serotonin degradation, FMO3 trimethylamine, choline and organic cation transport share amine handling; carnitine synthesis is a near fit.

label: Cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling
reason: IL-2/3/5/6/7/9, LIF, CNTF, G-CSF and STAT regulation terms all describe cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling.

label: Nuclear RNA polymerase I/II/III transcription
reason: Initiation, elongation and termination by Pol I, II (including HIV Tat) and III plus rRNA transcription/processing form one transcription machinery theme.

label: RNA modification and snoRNP/Cajal body
reason: rRNA/tRNA/snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation with snoRNP assembly and Cajal body localization are one RNA-modification theme.

label: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching
reason: VSMC differentiation, migration, proliferation and SRF-driven cytoskeletal targets all describe smooth muscle phenotype control.

label: Adrenergic GPCR cAMP-PKA signalling
reason: Adenylate cyclase activation/inhibition, adrenoceptors, PKA, PDE and catecholamine secretion regulation share the cAMP second-messenger axis.

label: Chromatin remodelling and protein acetylation
reason: BAF complex assembly, HATs, histone methylation and nucleosome organization dominate; a few terms (organism emergence, centriole replication, redox) are odd.

label: Centrosome, spindle and cilium organization
reason: Centriole duplication, MTOC nucleation, spindle orientation and basal body/cilium terms all concern microtubule organizing centres.

label: Selective autophagy and autophagosome formation
reason: Aggrephagy, mitophagy, pexophagy, reticulophagy, microautophagy, CMA and autophagosome assembly regulation are one autophagy theme.

label: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein metabolism
reason: Chylomicron and VLDL assembly, remodelling and clearance with LPL activation and dietary lipid digestion.

label: Platelet activation and haemostasis
reason: Platelet receptor signalling (GPVI, P2Y, PAR, TP, VWF/GPIb), degranulation, aggregation and coagulation; integrin adhesion module fits platelet adhesion.

label: Systemic energy homeostasis: insulin and adipose lipid
reason: Insulin secretion/signalling, glucose uptake and adipocyte lipid storage/thermogenesis linked by the insulin-adipose energy-balance axis; a few odd members (TALK channel, RHOQ).

label: Gastrulation, mesendoderm and left-right patterning
reason: Primitive streak, germ layer formation, Nodal signalling and left-right asymmetry of organs form one early embryonic patterning theme.

label: Renal and renin-angiotensin blood pressure control
reason: Angiotensin metabolism, renal sodium/volume regulation, vasopressin and natriuretic cGMP signalling all regulate blood pressure.

label: Bile acid metabolism and intestinal sterol absorption
reason: Bile acid synthesis, transport, recycling and signalling with ABCG5/8 sterol and canalicular transporter defects; fatty acid transport is minor.

label: B cell, germinal centre and plasma cells
reason: B cell/plasma cell signatures, germinal centre formation, Tfh/ICOS help and B cell proliferation all describe the B cell response.

label: Eye development, phototransduction and retinoid metabolism
reason: Retina/lens development and phototransduction linked to retinoid/vitamin A metabolism via the visual cycle and RA signalling; a few generic misfits.

label: RNA polymerase II initiation and elongation
reason: Pol II pre-initiation, promoter escape, CTD phosphorylation, capping, pausing and HIV Tat elongation are one transcription theme.

label: Ribosome biogenesis and Pol I/III transcription
reason: rRNA transcription and processing, Pol III transcription and MYC targets (MYC drives ribosome biogenesis); TFAP2A and inner cell mass are minor misfits.

label: T cell adhesion and immunological synapse
reason: Integrin activation, leukocyte adhesion/migration, immune synapse and T cell polarity form one lymphocyte adhesion theme.

label: Mitotic progression and APC/C regulation
reason: APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 degradation, sister chromatid cohesion, spindle checkpoint, PLK1/Aurora and cytokinesis all describe mitosis.

label: Camera-type eye development
reason: Lens, retina, cornea, iris, optic cup and hyaloid vasculature regression are all eye morphogenesis.

label: Autophagy and ESCRT endolysosomal sorting
reason: Selective autophagy and ESCRT/MVB sorting, viral budding and receptor downregulation linked by shared ESCRT and lysosomal degradation machinery.

label: Intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicrons
reason: Dietary lipid digestion, sterol absorption (ABCG5/8), chylomicron/VLDL assembly and vitamin E transport are one lipid absorption theme.

label: Lipid mediator GPCR signalling
reason: S1P, leukotriene and prostanoid receptors with Gbeta-gamma PLC/PI3Kgamma signalling are one lipid-GPCR theme.

label: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid and BCAA catabolism
reason: PDH/OGDH/BCKDH complexes, lipoylation, CoA and biotin cofactors, BCAA and lysine catabolism disorders share mitochondrial acyl-CoA metabolism.

label: Plasma lipoprotein assembly, remodelling and clearance
reason: Chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL assembly/remodelling/clearance with intestinal lipid absorption.

label: miRNA and post-transcriptional gene silencing
reason: miRNA biogenesis, RISC, ceRNA, miRNA-regulated translation and mRNA stability terms form one post-transcriptional regulation theme.

label: Platelet activation and haemostasis
reason: VWF/GPIb, GPVI, P2Y, PAR and TP signalling, degranulation and aggregation are all platelet function.

label: Viral RNA replication and host restriction
reason: Coronavirus replication/host translation and APOBEC cytidine deamination/editing linked by host-virus nucleic acid interactions; APOBEC ties editosome to HIV restriction.

label: Lysosomal glycosaminoglycan and glycan catabolism
reason: MPS disorders, HS/CS/KS degradation, glycosphingolipid and sialic acid catabolism are all lysosomal glycan breakdown.

label: Epidermis and ectodermal appendage development
reason: Keratinocyte differentiation, cornification, hair follicle, nail, tooth, sebaceous and mammary gland are ectodermal derivatives; inner ear and cranial ganglion are minor misfits.

label: Golgi organization and endosomal recycling
reason: Golgi assembly/disassembly, COPI budding, Rab/ARF GTPase regulation and endosome tubulation/recycling are one membrane trafficking theme.

label: Apical epithelial membrane transport
reason: Canalicular ABCB4/ABCB11 lipid and bile acid transport, CFTR, phospholipid flippases, rafts and apical localization share polarized apical membrane function.

label: Chaperone folding and protein quality control
reason: CCT/TriC and prefoldin folding, refolding, misfolded protein response, aggrephagy and ERAD form one proteostasis theme; RHOBTB2 is a misfit.

label: Aromatic and sulfur amino acid metabolism with cofactors
reason: Phe/Tyr catabolism with BH4, transsulfuration/sulfide oxidation with B6 and Moco, and selenium metabolism paralleling sulfur, linked by cofactor dependence.

label: Heart morphogenesis
reason: Endocardium, trabeculation, compact myocardium, septum and coronary vasculogenesis are all cardiac development.
